claims.text: A mixed-methods design is proposed to evaluate AI use in recruitment regarding efficiency, perceived fairness, candidate experience, and human review.
A questionnaire is proposed to collect responses from HR professionals, recruiters, job seekers, and employees.
Qualitative interviews with a smaller group of HR professionals are proposed to provide detailed operational examples.

evidence.description: This paper proposes a study of AI use in recruitment and selection, focusing on recruitment efficiency, perceived fairness, candidate experience, and the role of human review. A mixed-methods design is proposed.
A questionnaire would gather responses from HR professionals, recruiters, job seekers, and employees
while interviews with a smaller group of HR professionals would provide more detailed examples.

methodologies.name: Proposed mixed-methods evaluation design
methodologies.description: A proposed study combining a multi-stakeholder questionnaire with focused HR interviews and literature framing to evaluate AI recruitment tools.

limitations.text: The paper does not present completed survey findings; its hypotheses and sample plan are proposals to be tested.

future_work.text: Execute the proposed sample plan and survey to empirically test hypotheses regarding AI recruitment tools.
